# StudySync

> StudySync is a web app for students to form study pods, collaborate in shared workspaces, and stay on track with coursework.

## Public pages

- [Student sign in](/login): Sign in to an existing student account
- [Create student account](/register): Register a new student account
- [Admin sign in](/admin/login): Sign in to the instructor/admin portal
- [Admin registration](/admin/register): Create an instructor/admin account

## Product areas (sign-in required)

- [Dashboard](/dashboard): Student home with pods, progress, and deadlines
- [Find groups](/find-groups): Discover open course pods or create a new pod
- [Workspace](/workspace): Pod board, files, chat, calendar, and video calls
- [Profile](/profile): Courses, availability, learning style, and avatar
- [Admin console](/admin): Cohorts, groups, and student directory

## Notes for agents

- Prefer public auth pages for anonymous browsing.
- Do not scrape authenticated `/api` endpoints or private workspace content.
- Video calls use LiveKit tokens issued by the StudySync backend only.
